name: sap-abap-sql
description: Checks and fixes ABAP Open SQL for SAP's ADT data-preview console. Connects to nothing.
long_description:
The ADT data-preview console is the widest read surface an on-premise SAP system exposes over HTTP, and it is strict in ways its error messages do not explain. SUM(netwr), COUNT(DISTINCT kunnr) and (a OR b) each fail with a different-looking grammar error, and all three come from one rule: the parser wants a space on the inside of every parenthesis. This server knows that rule and the handful of others that cost people afternoons, including the hard 255-character statement ceiling.

It connects to nothing. There is no SAP system behind it, no credential, and no network call. Every tool is a pure function over a statement you pass in, so it is safe to run alongside whichever ADT client you already use.

tools.name: abap_sql_prepare
tools.description: Returns the statement to send, or refuses it and names the correction

tools.name: abap_sql_check
tools.description: Reports every dialect problem without rewriting, each with a stable rule id

tools.name: abap_sql_rules
tools.description: Lists the ways this dialect differs from standard SQL
